about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Eric Sorensen

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Mr. Chair, I rise today in strong opposition to the Grothman amendment.
Mr. Chair, I will not remain silent when this amendment is dropped at the eleventh hour to decimate our institution.
I urge Republicans and Democrats to please honor them with a ``no'' vote on amendment No. 316.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: I am proud to live in an Army town, and I am the only LGBTQ person to serve on the House Committee on Armed Services.
LGBTQ servicemembers are critical and essential to our Armed Forces.
Madam Chair, I rise today in strong opposition to Representative Boebert's amendment.
I urge my colleagues to reject this amendment because all Americans who serve should be able to serve with dignity, respect, and our Nation's thanks.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JAY P. LARSON POST OFFICE BUILDING
statements.title: JAY P. LARSON POST OFFICE BUILDING
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my legislation, H.R. 2466, which will redesignate the Rockford post office on Harrison Avenue in honor of Jay Larson.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise with my colleagues today to call out the House GOP's big billionaire bailout at the expense of my neighbors back home in Illinois-17.
The other side claims to be fiscally responsible, but they are blowing a $5 trillion hole in our national debt to do it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THANKING OUR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS AND THEIR FAMILIES
statements.title: THANKING OUR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS AND THEIR FAMILIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this is National Police Week when we honor the brave men and women who serve and protect us every day, but it is also a good reminder that they deserve our thanks every day.
We also need to thank the spouses and the children of our law enforcement who deal with the risk of their loved ones who may not come home.
Serving in the people's House means we support law enforcement.
I am proud to have secured funding for police training and safety.

That is why I am so proud of the Invest to Protect Act, my bipartisan legislation that gives small and midsized police departments the funding that they need for training, recruitment, and mental health resources.
Mr. Speaker, happy National Police Week.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVAT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVATION PROGRAM: ENERGY CONSERVATION...
sentences: However, what is being presented by my Republican colleagues today is a plan that would gut healthcare for 152,483 of my neighbors at home who depend on Medicaid, more than 66,000 kids under the age of 19.
Ten thousand seniors back home rely on Medicaid in Illinois' 17th District for their nursing home coverage.
Also, billionaire donors and big corporations get tax breaks to make them more wealthy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INCREASING PENALTIES FOR SCAMMERS
statements.title: INCREASING PENALTIES FOR SCAMMERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, across America, working families and seniors are feeling the high costs of goods.
My bipartisan legislation would increase the penalties for any scammer who thinks that they can use AI to make an easy buck off of a senior citizen by stealing their Social Security check.
